messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'veridian-prod' (vpc-12) GPU pressure spike detected. 95% GPU util, queue depth rising. Auto-threshold triggered at 1758001234.
oncall-alex: picking this up. Paging oncall. tagging @maria-sre for SRE lead.
maria-sre: on it. initial check: metrics show sustained tail latency increase ~600ms and 20% request queuing. No node failures.
raj-eng: adding context from model routing: Veridian tenant is pinned to pool veridian-prod; no burst policy enabled. Traffic pattern shows several large batch jobs started ~10m ago.
eng-maya: I see 3 jobs w/ long seq lengths, KV cache large. Could be single-tenant overload. Can we throttle or isolate?
jules-cs: Customer (Veridian) reports ~5% of requests seeing 502/504, their UI shows degraded autocomplete for some users. They're on a sales demo right now.
maria-sre: action list proposal: 1) Approve temporary burst to shared spare capacity (if allowed) 2) Pause/evict best-effort batch jobs from pool 3) Notify customer + mitigate with retry guidance. Need decision on (1).
oncall-alex: @raj-eng can we allow a 30m burst from shared capacity? What's risk to other tenants?
raj-eng: Shared spare capacity currently at ~40% free. Allowing a 30m burst for one tenant will reduce headroom for autoscale events across pools but acceptable if we cap at +2x for veridian. We'll set circuit to auto-fallback.
maria-sre: Maria -> Approve temporary burst + cap to 2x for 30m. I'll implement guardrail: abort if queue depth > 1000 or pod OOMs.
eng-maya: implementing now: applying patch to allocation policy, enabling tenantBurst=true, burstCap=2, burstTTL=1800. Patching in prod router.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for routing change (veridian burst policy). Rollout id: r-1758001250.
eng-maya: also evicting two large best-effort jobs from pool to free immediate slots: job-1123, job-1145.
maria-sre: monitoring closely. Setting a 5-min watch and will escalate if errors rise.
jules-cs: Notifying Veridian: "We've enabled a temporary capacity burst and are monitoring. Expect improved responsiveness in ~2-3 minutes. We'll follow up if further action needed"
oncall-alex: handoff to day SRE at 1758001600 if still active. @maria-sre stay on watch.
maria-sre: update @all at 1758001450: queue depth dropping, GPU util now 72%, error rate trending down to baseline. Burst at 2x seems to be handling load.
raj-eng: lowering priority: keep burst until 1758003034 (end of agreed 30m) unless customer requests extension. Also file a follow-up to discuss tenant isolation vs soft quotas for Veridian — propose a per-tenant burst allowance.
jules-cs: Veridian confirmed improvement and will postpone demo for 15m, appreciate quick response. :thumbsup:
maria-sre: closing timeframe: I'll create incident follow-up ticket for root cause + recommend rate-limits and batch-job gating.
one more note: logs snippet captured during peak: `GPU0 util 98% | queue_depth=842 | top_process=decoder_batch_3`
oncall-alex: thanks team. resolving channel at 1758001899, leaving postmortem action items assigned. :white_check_mark:
